definitions.explanation: Having a great deal of something; wealthy or plentiful in resources.
Having depth, richness, or fullness in terms of experience, emotion, or expression.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}が{豊|ゆた}かな{土地|とち}だ。
{自然|しぜん}が{豊|ゆた}かな{地域|ちいき}に{住|す}みたい。
examples.english: I want to live in an area rich in nature.

examples.japanese: {豊|ゆた}かな{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}りたい。
examples.english: I want to live a comfortable/prosperous life.

examples.japanese: この{国|くに}は{資源|しげん}が{豊|ゆた}かで、{石油|せきゆ}や{天然|てんねん}ガスがたくさん{採|と}れる。
examples.english: This country is rich in resources, producing a lot of oil and natural gas.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}の{幸|さち}が{豊|ゆた}かな{地方|ちほう}では、{新鮮|しんせん}な{魚|さかな}がいつでも{手|て}に{入|はい}る。
examples.english: In regions abundant in seafood, fresh fish is always available.

examples.japanese: {豊|ゆた}かな{経験|けいけん}を{持|も}っている。
{表情|ひょうじょう}が{豊|ゆた}かな{人|ひと}は{魅力|みりょく}{的|てき}だ。
examples.english: People with expressive faces are attractive.
examples.notes: 表情が豊か = expressive, rich in facial expressions

examples.japanese: {心|こころ}が{豊|ゆた}かな{人|ひと}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become a person with a rich heart.
examples.notes: 心が豊か = having inner richness/depth

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{感性|かんせい}が{豊|ゆた}かで、{音楽|おんがく}や{美術|びじゅつ}に{深|ふか}い{理解|りかい}がある。
examples.english: She has a rich sensibility and a deep understanding of music and art.

examples.japanese: {想像力|そうぞうりょく}が{豊|ゆた}かな{子供|こども}は、いつも{面白|おもしろ}い{話|はなし}を{作|つく}ってくれる。
examples.english: Children with rich imaginations always come up with interesting stories.

notes:
USAGE: {豊|ゆた}か can describe material abundance (resources, nature) or abstract richness (experience, emotions, expressions).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{自然|しぜん}が{豊|ゆた}か (rich in nature)
・{豊|ゆた}かな{経験|けいけん} (rich experience)
・{表情|ひょうじょう}が{豊|ゆた}か (expressive, rich in facial expressions)
・{豊|ゆた}かな{生活|せいかつ} (prosperous life)
・{心|こころ}が{豊|ゆた}か (having a rich heart/spirit)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{富|と}む - to be rich in (verb)
・{裕福|ゆうふく} - wealthy, affluent (financial)
